==Quest information==
===Requirements===
*This quest is only offered to [[level]] 20 [[character]]s.

===Objectives===
*Win a battle in the [[Heroes' Ascent]].
*See Zenjal <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen Order|Zaishen]] Guide] for your reward.

===Reward===
*5,000 [[Experience]]
*[[Hero's Strongbox]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Zenjal [Zaishen Guide]
:''"The journey to [[The Hall of Heroes (arena)|the Hall of Heroes]] is no easy road. Do you have the strength to progress on that path? Show me your resolve by achieving victory over your foes in Heroes' Ascent."''
{{Offer dialog
| accept = I'll show you what being a hero means.
| decline = I never claimed to be a hero.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue ===
;Zenjal [Zaishen Guide]
:''"To compete in Heroes' Ascent, you must journey to the Battle Isles. If you wish, I can send you directly to [[Heroes' Ascent (outpost)|the staging area]]. Is your heart prepared for the flames of battle? "''
{{Offer dialog
| accept = Let's do it.
| decline = Not now.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zenjal [Zaishen Guide]
:''"Doubtless you and your companions will one day be counted among the mightiest heroes."''
